notes.title: Ver2.0 Major Update is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Clock Rogue!

We have released the Ver2.0 major update for Clock Rogue.
The update includes the following changes:

・Added two new playable characters.

・Added a Library feature where you can check all the moves in the game.

・Added new achievements and an in-game trophy system.

・Added a product refresh feature in the shop.

・Added a feature that you can check the calender in the battle scene.

・Increased the variety of NPC dialogue in the schedule screen.

・Changed the ability of the mid-boss "Dokumet."
　　Before: Change 12 empty slots into deadly poison.
　　After: Change 4 occupied slots into deadly poison.

・Adjusted the damage of deadly poison.
　　Before: 7 damage
　　After: 10 damage

・Added new effects for the Hard Mode boss.

Future updates are currently undecided, but any bugs related to this update will be fixed immediately.
If you encounter any issues, please report them in the bug report thread on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Free major update is coming on March 14th!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has been enjoying Clock Rogue!

We have decided to release the major update for Clock Rogue on March 14th.
This update will introduce two new characters along with other features. 

Please stay tuned and look forward to it!
